title: Need a tileset to fit the Magic DLC for MV

posts.author: ericjustin81
posts.body: If anyone has a tile set that pairs well aesthetically with the RPG Maker MV DLC for called Magic Outside D, then Magic Inside D and D2, I'd appreciate it. It feels like you could make a really need witch's house in the woods with those roof pieces, but I can't find a building tile that compliments it well at all.
